The '''Third Recon Company''' was a unit of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that included a unit commanded by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Molcarrus]]. They were deployed on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], near [[Kaas City]].<ref name="TOR" />
